data.description: Adds ruby sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots.
data.name: Gear set

meta.notes: The mod metadata, written to fabric.mod.json when you export the Fabric mod jar. New items and blocks exist only in that jar, which also needs Fabric API and msm_runtime (nested in the jar unless you choose a separate runtime). The mod id must stay unique among the mods you install.
